Hello all,
when i am typing this command of acccheck.

acccheck -t 192.168.0.4 -u user -p password

it is showing "End of Scan" that's it.
i had tried another commands.like
./acccheck -t 192.168.0.4 -u user -p password

acccheck -t 192.168.0.4 -U users.txt -P passwords.txt

but it is showing regularly "End of Scan"
while i am using the newest version of acccheck.

Thanks | pls help
i have solved this problem; i've found the solution. this was the problem of Network configuration settings of my victim.
